stories.title: Follow live: Jaguars dominating Ravens in Baltimore
Source: Texas RB Smothers done for season with torn MCL amid injury woes
stories.summary: Hollywood Smothers will miss the rest of the season for the No. 7 Longhorns, who are seeing their injury issues mount.

stories.title: Chiefs WR Rice files for bankruptcy, claims he owes over $3.45M in debts
stories.summary: Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice filed for bankruptcy in federal court, claiming he has more than $3.45 million in debts.

stories.title: No. 5 Michigan takes down No. 2 UConn in program's highest-ranked win ever
stories.summary: Michigan scored the highest-ranked win in program history, stunning No. 2 UConn 77-66 on Thursday in the first matchup of top-five women's teams at Crisler Center.

stories.title: LIV Golf calls it quits, to shutter league without financial support for 2.0 model
stories.summary: LIV Golf confirmed it is winding down operations after the league couldn't get the necessary financial commitment and player support to proceed with LIV 2.0.
